reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Supporting Uganda's Response to HIV/AIDS - Uganda (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Uganda, HIV, Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development of the Republic of Uganda (MoFPED)This program has the following goals: An effective and sustainable multi-sectoral HIV/AIDS service delivery system that ensures universal access and coverage of quality, efficient and safe services to the targeted population by 2020. To decrease HIV-associated morbidity and mortality by 70% through achieving and maintaining 90% viral suppression by 2020. To reduce the number of new youth and adult infections by 70% and the number of new paediatric HIV infections by 95% by 2020. To reduce vulnerability to HIV/AIDS and mitigation of its impact on PLHIV and other vulnerable groups. The objectives of this program are: To increase condom use at high risk sex from 50% to 75%. To increase equitable access to ART by those in need from 50%(2014) To 80% by 2018
